decisions.reason: Narrowing dashboard design coverage to shell-container styling does not change the independently accepted responsive guidance for website pages.
The console-shell scope change does not alter the independently accepted theme and shared-chrome rules for website pages.
Limiting console work to shell-container styling does not change the requirement to share the website footer across webpages.
The dashboard canvas exclusion and shell-container focus do not modify responsive behavior for the landing page.
The console-shell design narrowing does not change the landing-page section's position, presentation, or steps.
The shell-container styling decision is separate from the landing page's established visual theme and hero styling.
The console-shell scope change does not affect whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The decision to request only shell-container styling guidance does not alter the landing-page sign-up button.
